C.name: WsNewsletterDocument
C.source:
model WsNewsletterDocument {
  id String @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId String @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  ownerId String @map("owner_id")
  name String
  revision Int @default(1)
  status String @default("draft")
  config Json
  design Json
  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  updatedAt DateTime @updatedAt @map("updated_at")
  comments WsNewsletterComment[]
  stages WsNewsletterStage[]
  reviewers WsNewsletterReviewer[]
  invitations WsNewsletterInvitation[]
  @@unique([id, tenantId], map: "ws_newsletter_document_tenant_key")
  @@index([tenantId, ownerId, updatedAt])
  @@map("ws_newsletter_document")
}

model WsNewsletterAsset {
  id String @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId String @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  ownerId String @map("owner_id")
  name String
  token String @unique
  mimeType String @map("mime_type")

  createdAt DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at")
  deletedAt DateTime? @map("deleted_at")
  revisionRootId String? @map("revision_root_id") @db.Uuid
  revisionParentId String? @map("revision_parent_id") @db.Uuid

  revisionRoot WsNewsletterAsset? @relation("NewsletterImageRoot", fields: [revisionRootId, tenantId, ownerId], references: [id, tenantId, ownerId], onDelete: NoAction, onUpdate: NoAction, map: "ws_newsletter_asset_revision_root_scope_fkey")

  derivedImages WsNewsletterAsset[] @relation("NewsletterImageParent")
  folderId String? @map("folder_id") @db.Uuid
  folder WsNewsletterAssetFolder? @relation(fields: [folderId, tenantId, ownerId], references: [id, tenantId, ownerId], onDelete: NoAction, map: "ws_newsletter_asset_folder_scope_fkey")
  @@index([tenantId, ownerId])
  @@index([tenantId, ownerId, folderId])
  @@unique([id, tenantId, ownerId], map: "ws_newsletter_asset_scope_key")
  @@unique([revisionRootId, revisionNumber], map: "ws_newsletter_asset_revision_number_key")
  @@index([tenantId, ownerId, currentRevision, deletedAt])
  @@map("ws_newsletter_asset")
}

C.name: OutreachDraftVersion
C.source:
model OutreachDraftVersion {
  id                String   @id @default(uuid()) @db.Uuid
  tenantId          String   @map("tenant_id") @db.Uuid
  artifactId        String   @map("artifact_id") @db.Uuid
  version           Int
  /// The version this one was edited/improved/reverted FROM; null for a fresh generation.
  sourceVersionId   String?  @map("source_version_id") @db.Uuid
  subject           String   @db.Text
  body              String   @db.Text
  /// Set only by the server-side Workspace newsletter importer. Generic edits
  /// use the default outreach format and cannot inherit this authority.
  contentFormat     String   @default("outreach") @map("content_format") @db.VarChar(32)
  newsletterStageId String?  @map("newsletter_stage_id") @db.Uuid
  /// sha256 of subject+body — what the audit verdict and any approval attach to.
  contentHash       String   @map("content_hash") @db.VarChar(80)
  /// 'generated' | 'manually_authored' | 'generation_failed'
  generationStatus  String   @map("generation_status") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// 'not_required' | 'pending' | 'passed' | 'warning' | 'held' | 'unavailable'
  auditStatus       String   @map("audit_status") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// 'not_required' | 'pending' | 'approved' | 'rejected'
  approvalStatus    String   @map("approval_status") @db.VarChar(32)
  /// The AuditorMode this verdict ran under ('shadow' | 'annotate' | 'enforce').
  auditMode         String?  @map("audit_mode") @db.VarChar(16)
  /// runAuditor decision, or 'audit_unavailable' when a control itself failed.
  auditDecision     String?  @map("audit_decision") @db.VarChar(32)
  auditFindings     Json?    @map("audit_findings_jsonb")
  /// The structured auditor ledger entries this exact text was judged against.
  auditLedger       Json     @default("[]") @map("audit_ledger_jsonb")
  reviewRequestId   String?  @map("review_request_id") @db.Uuid
  contextPacketId   String?  @map("context_packet_id") @db.Uuid
  provider          String?  @db.VarChar(32)
  model             String?  @db.VarChar(160)
  promptSpecVersion String?  @map("prompt_spec_version") @db.VarChar(32)
  createdByUserId   String   @map("created_by_user_id") @db.Uuid
  createdAt         DateTime @default(now()) @map("created_at") @db.Timestamptz(6)

  tenant          Tenant                 @relation(fields: [tenantId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  artifact        OutreachDraftArtifact  @relation(fields: [artifactId], references: [id], onDelete: Cascade)
  sourceVersion   OutreachDraftVersion?  @relation("OutreachDraftVersionLineage", fields: [sourceVersionId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  derivedVersions OutreachDraftVersion[] @relation("OutreachDraftVersionLineage")
  reviewRequest   ReviewRequest?         @relation(fields: [reviewRequestId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  contextPacket   ContextPacket?         @relation(fields: [contextPacketId], references: [id], onDelete: SetNull)
  createdBy       User                   @relation("OutreachDraftVersionAuthor", fields: [createdByUserId], references: [id], onDelete: Restrict)
  deliveries      OutreachDelivery[]

  @@unique([artifactId, version], map: "outreach_draft_versions_artifact_version")
  @@index([tenantId, auditStatus, approvalStatus], map: "outreach_draft_versions_tenant_audit_approval_idx")
  @@map("outreach_draft_versions")
}
